title: feat: add deterministic PR sequencer
summary: Adds a read-only multi-PR sequencer that selects at most one exact next platform-review candidate and holds stale concurrent work.
changeNotes: Composes explicit sequence policy, deterministic handoff receipts, and live GitHub receiver state.
Requires exact head, exact current checkpoint base, green named checks, CLEAN merge state, and non-draft status.
Emits one compact next-action handoff and requires a full reprobe after any external action.
riskNotes: Technical NEXT_READY is evidence for review ordering, not approval or merge authority.
GitHub state can change after observation, so platform must recheck the exact receiver state before action.
followUps: Publish only after the prerequisite checkpoint and publisher PRs are merged and the branch is rebased.
Platform Axiom/Mir independently reviews; local Keel does not merge or change CANON.
